newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: DBS Bank appoints new president.
newsitem.headline: DBS Bank appoints new president.

text.p: The Development Bank of Singapore Ltd said on Sunday it has appointed Ng Kee Choe as president and chief operating officer to help expand the bank's activities in the Asia-Pacific region.

DBS also said it had appointed Tan Soo Nan to deputy president in charge of the international banking arm of DBS Bank. Soh Kim Soon has been appointed chairman of DBS Securities Holding Pte Ltd and DBS Finance Ltd.

"The appointments will better position us to seize opportunites domestically and internationally in all areas of activities in banking and financial services," said Ngiam Tong Dow, chairman and chief executive officer of DBS Bank in a statement.
The bank made no statement on the bank's previous president.
